name: MultiMedQA
intro: MultiMedQA是Google Research与DeepMind提出的综合医疗问答评测套件，汇集六个既有英文数据集，覆盖专业医学考试、生物医学研究和消费者健康问答，并新增含3,375条常见搜索问题的HealthSearchQA；论文分别使用多选准确率和临床医生人工评测考察模型。

intro_en: MultiMedQA is a comprehensive medical QA suite introduced by Google Research and DeepMind. It combines six existing English datasets spanning professional exams, biomedical research, and consumer health QA, and adds HealthSearchQA with 3,375 commonly searched questions; the paper evaluates multiple-choice tasks by accuracy and long-form answers through clinician review.

drawio_review_note: Re-reviewed against arXiv:2212.13138 Sections 3.1-3.3, 4.1-4.5, Table 1, and Appendix A. The diagram separates compilation of six existing English medical QA datasets from construction of the 3,375-question HealthSearchQA set, then preserves the paper's two evaluation branches: exact-choice accuracy on four multiple-choice groups with few-shot, chain-of-thought, and 11-path self-consistency prompting; and blinded clinician review of 140 long-form questions sampled as 100 HealthSearchQA, 20 LiveQA, and 20 MedicationQA items. It also records nine clinicians and the paper's consensus, reasoning, completeness, harm, bias, relevance, and helpfulness dimensions.
